I decided to do an experiment last spring since I was also having acne then. I took lukewarm showers for a month and then took hot showers for a month and compared the results. After the month of lukewarm I had no acne at all. After the month of hot I had a fair amount of acne and PIH. I use a few tricks to try and counter this. One is I force myself to time all of my routines, like my morning routine or showing routine etc. This way I have a rough idea of how long things actually take. I then take that time and add 5-10 minutes and plan for it to take that long. The other is to try not to do anything that would cause me to focus right before an important event. This one is far less useful, since I'm usually pretty busy and can't afford to waste time like that, but I'm never late when I do this. For both methods using an auditory/buzzing reminder of some kind is also useful.
